items.title: Chuck Mancuso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 10, 2013
items.q: He said, “What are you, John Wayne?”

ctx.x: And what was your master’s in?

My first master’s I had a fellowship here in ’69-’70 in Ex Ed. So they paid for everything, it was great. One of the guys at Cole’s said to Dr. Dobby, he said, “Charles, you’re in your third year of teaching at Baker Hall. You know you’ve got two more years to get the master’s.” I didn’t even know this guy that well. And he said, “I worked on something. I have a fellowship for you. Twenty-six hundred dollars, all books are paid for, you have your little apartment, you won’t have to worry about that, you do all…
Well let me ask you about a few things. In your book Popular Music —
